  │ 6 × anthropic/*          │ ok    │ ok     │ ok         │ ok      │ ok      │ 5           │
  ├──────────────────────────┼───────┼────────┼────────────┼─────────┼─────────┼─────────────┤
  │ anthropic/claude-fable-5 │ ok    │ ok     │ ok         │ ok      │ missing │ 5 (derived) │
  ├──────────────────────────┼───────┼────────┼────────────┼─────────┼─────────┼─────────────┤
  │ openai/gpt-5.6-sol       │ ok    │ ok     │ ok         │ ok      │ missing │ 4           │
  ├──────────────────────────┼───────┼────────┼────────────┼─────────┼─────────┼─────────────┤
  │ openai/gpt-5.6-terra     │ ok    │ ok     │ ok         │ ok      │ missing │ 4           │
  ├──────────────────────────┼───────┼────────┼────────────┼─────────┼─────────┼─────────────┤
  │ openai/gpt-5.5           │ ok    │ ok     │ ok         │ missing │ missing │ 3           │
  ├──────────────────────────┼───────┼────────┼────────────┼─────────┼─────────┼─────────────┤
  │ z-ai/glm-5.2             │ ok    │ ok     │ ok         │ missing │ missing │ 3           │
  └──────────────────────────┴───────┴────────┴────────────┴─────────┴─────────┴─────────────┘

  Because derivation is gated on is_anthropic, Anthropic models always reach 5 (fable-5's missing cache_write_1h gets derived — that path is load-bearing today). The four non-Anthropic ids never will.

  So "require all five classes" would emit zero rows for 7 of the 14 mapped keys, permanently, every day — the 3 OpenAI models plus all 4 GLM spellings. They'd price at $0 outright, where today they correctly price
  input, output and cache_read — and cache_read is the 96% class. That's a large regression, not a safety improvement.

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 ☐ Revised fix

Given that non-Anthropic models never publish cache-write prices, how should the partial-capture hazard be handled?

❯ 1. Forward-fill per class       ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
    (Recommended)                 │ 07-01: in,out,cr,cw5,cw1 present               │
                                  │ 07-10: in,out only (partial capture)           │
                                  │   -> cr/cw5/cw1 inherit 07-01 -> cost intact   │
                                  │                                                │
                                  │ glm-5.2 every day: in,out,cr only              │
                                  │   -> cw5/cw1 never seen -> stay unpriced       │
                                  │      (correct: no rate exists to inherit)      │
                                  │                                                │
                                  │ No model loses pricing it has today.           │
                                  └────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
